perform request and keep the file as returned by the API

Source: R/build_request.R
handle_file_resp.Rd

Unlike [handle_resp], the body of any file type is returned as raw bytes, with no parsing. The CSV that the API uses to report errors and lists of file versions (`ECAFileinfo.csv`, or an unnamed CSV with `ErrorCode`) is parsed as in [handle_resp].

Usage

handle_file_resp(req)

Arguments

req

A httr2 request object.

Value

a data.table if the response is a CSV report of the API. Otherwise a list with the raw `body`, `filename` (from the Content-Disposition header, NULL if missing), `content_type` and HTTP `status`.
